goal: Target: 172.17.0.12. Identify open ports and known vulnerabilities.

chain.command: naabu -host 172.17.0.12 -silent | tee naabu_out.txt | nuclei -silent -severity critical,high,medium -t http/

goal: Target: 172.25.0.2-172.25.0.7. Identify open ports and known vulnerabilities.

chain.command: masscan -p21,22,25,53,80,110,143,3306,8080 172.25.0.2-172.25.0.7 --rate 1000 --wait 0 -oG /tmp/masscan_out.txt >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep '^Timestamp' /tmp/masscan_out.txt | awk -F'\t' '{host=$2; sub(/^Host: /,"",host); sub(/ \(\)$/,"",host); port=$3; sub(/^Ports: /,"",port); split(port,pp,"/"); print host":"pp[1]}' | tee /tmp/massaged_targets.txt >/dev/null && while IFS=: read -r host port; do nmap -sV -p"$port" --open -oG - "$host" 2>/dev/null | grep 'Ports:'; done < /tmp/massaged_targets.txt | awk -F'\t' '{n=split($2,f,"/"); if (f[7] != "") print f[7]}' | sed -E 's/ \(.*\)//; s/ (httpd|smtpd|pop3d|imapd)( |$)/ /' | sort -u | tee /tmp/versions_normalized.txt >/dev/null && while read -r v; do echo "--- $v ---"; searchsploit "$v" 2>&1; done < /tmp/versions_normalized.txt

goal: Target: 172.17.0.12. Identify open ports and known vulnerabilities.

chain.command: nmap -sV --script vuln,http-enum -p80 172.17.0.12 2>/dev/null | tee /tmp/nmap_vuln_out.txt | grep -oE 'CVE-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]+' | sort -u | tee /tmp/cves_found.txt | while read -r cve; do echo "--- $cve ---"; searchsploit --cve "$cve" 2>&1; done

goal: Target: 172.17.0.12. Identify open ports and known vulnerabilities.

chain.command: echo '172.17.0.12:80' | httpx-toolkit -silent | tee /tmp/httpx_out.txt | nuclei -silent -severity critical,high,medium -t http/
